name: Zack Morris | SPY & QQQ Levels
zh_summary: MrZackMorris 對 $QQQ 開盤進行回測。58 個早晨中有 60 個反彈。但買入第一個回調往往虧損。真正的低點通常在 9:45 到 10 點之間。讓它掃過盤前低點並等待蠟燭收盤回升上方，在小樣本中贏得 70-78% 的時間。耐心有回報。不是買入信號。推廣 Trade the Zones 指標，每月 $5 持續 3 個月，代碼 ZACK5。
text:
Been running backtests on the $QQQ open.

It bounced on 58 of 60 mornings.

But buying the first dip lost more often than not.

The real low usually came between 9:45 and 10.

Letting it sweep PM low and waiting for a candle to close back above won 70-78% of the time in a small sample.

Patience pays.

Not a buy signal.

My Trade the Zones indicator: $5 a month for 3 months with code ZACK5

https://whop.com/trade-the-zones/trade-the-zones-indicator
